name: Ardent Passions
source:
Ardent Passions is an adult visual novel where Heroman uncovers his girlfriend and her friends' vigilante secrets on a camping trip. With the fate of these relationships at stake, the game unfolds through decisions that determine if these vigilantes become allies or enemies.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537220/Ardent_Passions/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《热情激情》是一部成人视觉小说，英雄曼在一次露营旅行中揭开了女友和她朋友的私刑秘密。随着这些关系的命运受到威胁，游戏的展开决定了这些义务警员是成为盟友还是敌人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537220/Ardent_Passions/]Steam[/url]]
